mapper.select: SELECT c.*, p.name as product_name, p.price as product_price, p.image_url as product_image_url, p.stock as product_stock FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_time DESC
SELECT c.*, p.name as product_name, p.price as product_price, p.image_url as product_image_url, p.stock as product_stock FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.*, p.name as product_name, p.price as product_price, p.image_url as product_image_url, p.stock as product_stock FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, selected) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{selected})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cart SET selected = #{selected} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
